name: Muhammad Rafli Nurfathan
about_text: As a highly motivated fresh graduate in Informatics from Universitas Bhinneka Nusantara (GPA 3.71), I possess practical, hands-on experience in both Web and Mobile Development. My background includes developing web applications with Laravel, Livewire, and PHP, as well as building Android apps utilizing Kotlin, Clean Architecture, and Unit Testing during Bangkit Academy 2024. Backed by Web Developer (BNSP) and Ethical Hacking Essentials (EC-Council) certifications, I am entirely focused on kickstarting and growing my career in Software Development.
